from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class CompanyEPS(BaseModel):
    """One company's basic earnings per share from its financial report."""
    company_name: str | None = Field(description="Company name as reported in the document")
    security_code: str | None = Field(description="Stock/security code if available")
    basic_earnings_per_share: float | None = Field(description="Basic earnings per share value for the reported period")
    period: str | None = Field(description="Financial report period, e.g., '2024年第一季度'")
    unit: str | None = Field(description="Unit of EPS, typically '元/股'")
    quote: str | None = Field(description="Brief excerpt from the document showing this EPS value")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    company_eps_list: list[CompanyEPS]
